Description
The 1 oz Argor Heraeus gold bar is a high-quality investment product made by one of the world’s leading precious metals refineries. Each Argor Heraeus gold bar contains 1 troy ounce of 99.99% pure gold, making it a valuable addition to any investment portfolio.
The
1 oz Gold Bar
is stamped with the Argor Heraeus logo, the weight and purity of the gold, and a unique serial number for authentication purposes. 1 oz Argor Heraeus gold bars.9999 pure gold also comes with an assay certificate that verifies the weight, purity, and authenticity.
Investors who choose 1 oz Argor Heraeus gold bars can be confident that they are investing in a product of exceptional quality and value. With a long-standing reputation for excellence, Argor Heraeus Gold Bar is a trusted name in the precious metals industry.
We have two different designs of these gold bars. The standard version  in the Black assay and a green version which has a certificate showing that the gold has been traced to its source. There is a QR coded which can be scanned allowing you to view the data held about your particular gold bar.
Sourced from top-tier professional mining partners, the Origin Traced line combines responsibly sourced gold with a full traceability system, making it an ideal choice for those looking to invest in gold responsibly and consciously
Design of Argor Heraeus Gold Bar 1 oz
On the obverse of these 1 Oz Gold Bar Argor Heraeus features numerous elements which are arranged vertically down the face of the bar. These include the Argor-Heraeus stamp at the top. Below you’ll find the inscription “Switzerland” along with the bar’s weight and the purity indicated. An assayers label with a specific serial number can also be found at the bottom of the 1 oz argor Heraeus gold bar 9999 fine.
The reverse side of the Argor Heraeus gold bar 1 oz may either feature the Argros-Heraeus logo in a repeating pattern or may feature a blank design or even the words “Origin Traced” & a padlock logo.
Main Highlights of 1 oz Argor Heraeus Gold Bar
Each Argor Heraeus gold bullion bar contains 1 Oz of .9999 pure gold from the Swiss refinery Argor-Heraeus.
Each Argor Heraeus 1 oz gold bar is delivered in a protective sealed assay card.
The 1 oz Argor Heraeus gold bar is eligible for precious metal IRAs.
Features its own Argor-Heraeus logo, Purity, and Weight.
Argor Heraeus Gold Bars has its own unique serial number for added security and theft protection.
